_comment: The SILENT-FAILURE shape from the registered description of voice_presence_get: { extensions: [], channels_ok: false } is what comes back when the tenant is unprovisioned, when the voice_server call threw and was swallowed, or when channel state is down - the route emits no 5xx, so an empty list must never be read as 'nobody is on a call' or 'nobody is registered'. Served verbatim minus this key.
